_README: Sealed expected values for the DEBT-ONLY labour backing ratio. Do not open until your rebuild is complete and written down. Definition and method are in notes/replication_brief_debt_only.md. Tolerance: abs 0.005 on every ratio, abs 0.01 on the coefficient of variation.
_vintage: Z.1 annual, latest complete year 2025. Series resolved from the Z.1 CSV package.

all_claims.2025.direct.note: the comparator; equity is in the denominator

_structural_bound: DEBT_ONLY_ratio_direct >= all_claims_ratio_direct in EVERY year. Removing a class with zero labour backing from the denominator cannot lower the ratio. If your rebuild violates this, the error is in the class list, not in the data.

_largest_judgement_call.name: THE ONE-STEP RULE: business classes take the indirect share
_largest_judgement_call.note: the one-step rule. It moves the debt-only ratio far less than the all-claims one.
